vertical\n- Component padding: 14pxÔÇô32px\n- Grid gutter: 16pxÔÇô24px\n- Border radius scale: 12px (UI), 20px (cards)\n\n### Depth \u0026 Elevation\n\n**ZERO SHADOWS** ÔÇö Revolut uses no shadows. Depth comes from:\n1. Color contrast (dark + light sections)\n2. Generous whitespace\n3. Border color (1px `#c9c9cd`)\n4.
